stories.title: Jio sets price band for Rs 30,000 crore IPO
stories.summary: Jio Platforms announced a price band of Rs 1,065 to Rs 1,119 per share for its upcoming IPO. At the lower end, the issue could raise about Rs 28,755 crore; at the top of the band, proceeds could reach roughly Rs 30,213 crore. The filing provides the range and the corresponding potential size of the offering.
stories.why: The size of the offering could affect market activity and investor allocation.

stories.title: Wholesale price index inflation rises to 11.39% in September, up from 9.9% in August
stories.summary: India’s wholesale price index (WPI) accelerated to 11.39% year‑on‑year in September, driven by higher fuel and food costs. Retail inflation also climbed to 5.54% in the same month, largely because of rising vegetable prices. Concerns remain that uneven monsoon rainfall, El Nino risks and higher global commodity prices could keep food‑price pressures elevated.
stories.why: The rise highlights heightened price pressures that could sustain overall inflation trends.

stories.title: A tough housing market could revive multigenerational homes, poll suggests
stories.summary: More than half (53 per cent) of respondents looking to buy their next or first home within the next two years said they would consider living in a multi-generational home, the RBC Home Ownership Poll found. Among prospective buyers, 34 per cent said multi-generational living is becoming more common because of housing affordability, while 32 per cent said it was a “smart way” for families to manage housing costs.

stories.title: India's inflation hits 5.54%: Onion prices up 108%, food inflation 7.74%
stories.summary: India's retail inflation rose to 5.54% in September 2026, the highest this year, as food inflation jumped to 7.74%. Onion prices more than doubled, while potatoes and tomatoes got cheaper.

stories.title: Floqer’s AI agents research sales prospects so teams don’t have to
stories.summary: Floqer is an autonomous customer knowledge platform that provides business-to-business sales and marketing teams with an AI-powered database designed to continuously collect, organize, and update the information used to understand their customers. Floqer also says it has surpassed $1.2 million in annual recurring revenue (ARR), and that its overall revenue has grown roughly tenfold over the past year.
stories.why: This matters because it could change AI capabilities, costs, adoption, regulation or competitive positioning.

stories.title: Starlink restrictions in Ukraine linked to political situation, says Zelensky aide
stories.summary: On 14 October 2026 the BBC reported that a Ukrainian presidential aide said recent restrictions on the Starlink satellite‑internet service in the war are connected to the country’s political situation. The article notes the aide’s comment linking the limits to political factors.
stories.why: Starlink is a key communications tool for Ukraine’s defence and civilian services, so any politically driven restrictions could have strategic implications.
